name: In Search of Menara Voidrender

meta.next: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe

summary: Zevrost sends warlocks from Orgrimmar to seek Menara Voidrender in the Barrens. He warns that fel magic leads to demonic enslavement, yet points them toward a mentor who can help fashion powerful arcane vestments.

sections.title: Warnings in the Shadows
sections.body: Warlocks gather beneath Orgrimmar in the Cleft of Shadow, where their presence is tolerated uneasily. Zevrost, one of their bitter tutors, sneers at acolytes who seek mastery of the dark arts. He believes those who delve deeper into fel magic only hasten their own enslavement. In his view, demonic addiction will eventually overtake every practitioner, turning even the most disciplined scholar into a thrall of the Twisting Nether.

sections.title: The Path to Ratchet
sections.body: Zevrost admits that other warlocks do not share his bleak view. Word has reached Orgrimmar of Menara Voidrender, a skilled warlock on the bluffs overlooking Ratchet, the neutral goblin port. Menara seeks promising disciples to help craft specialized implements for wielding their arcane might. For warlocks eager to advance their craft, her summons begins the forging of the legendary Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe.

sections.title: A Pragmatic Fellowship
sections.body: Menara waits high above Ratchet, where the realities of warlock society are plain. Warlocks must set aside racial and cultural rivalries and support one another. The demons they bargain with show no prejudice and no mercy to anyone who falters. Sharing knowledge and crafting protective vestments comes from practical need, not noble charity: warlocks must survive the hostile entities they bind to their service.

aliases: who starts in search of menara voidrender
faq.answer: Zevrost is an orc warlock trainer in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. He distrusts the pursuit of fel power and sees ambitious warlocks as fools destined for slavery to demonic corruption.
Menara Voidrender is an accomplished warlock in the Barrens, on the cliffs overlooking Ratchet. She mentors rising warlocks and helps them gather rare reagents to make potent ceremonial robes.

faq.q: Why does Zevrost think all warlocks are fools?
faq.answer: Zevrost believes fel magic inevitably corrupts and enslaves anyone who tries to master it. He thinks no practitioner can resist addiction, and that seeking greater power only hastens their downfall.

faq.q: Where can Menara Voidrender be found?
faq.answer: Menara is in the Barrens, on the high hills overlooking Ratchet. Warlocks travel east across the arid savannah to reach her camp overlooking the port.

faq.q: Why do warlocks from different races work together?
faq.answer: As Menara explains, demons summoned by warlocks show cruel malice to anyone who fails to control them. Survival depends on precision, so warlocks share knowledge and tools across cultural boundaries.

faq.q: What happens after finding Menara Voidrender?
faq.answer: Menara enlists the warlock to gather exotic, potent materials from across Azeroth to make the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe, a garment protective against fel energies.

angles.text: As a warlock, you travel under Menara Voidrender's guidance to assemble your own iconic Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe, a rite of passage for Horde warlocks.
As a Horde warlock, you face the contempt of traditional shamans and warriors. You find shelter in hidden places such as Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow or on neutral ground near Ratchet.
